voice.status: Frank at 0.95 selected for the three-lesson beta pilot; physical-device listening feedback remains pending.

scope: One brief payoff at lesson completion, never after each question. These ten drafts do not replace authored teaching, existing court cues or Pro Lens.
principles: Two short sentences; one concrete decision reminder.
Aim for roughly 2–3 seconds, allowing natural pacing; measure recordings rather than promise duration.
No praise tied to scores, applause overlap, or appended slogan on every ending.
See it. Own it. remains an occasional brand-line proposal, not the repeated learning payoff.
First listen to three contrasting sentence shapes; refine wording and delivery before recording all ten.
Then test three full completion journeys with readable matching transcript, mute, replay, background and navigation behavior before expanding.
Judge useful recall and desire to hear it again; replay counts alone do not establish learning or retention.

lessons.title: The Short Ball Is Not Permission
lessons.existingCourtCue: High: go. Low: lift and come in.
lessons.text: Check the height. Choose the shot.
lessons.basis: Height changes whether the short ball supports a controlled drive or a lifted approach; the full lesson also checks balance and opponent position.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: The Serve Writes the Next Question
lessons.existingCourtCue: Serve the question. Hit the space.
lessons.text: Plan the next ball. Read the return.
lessons.basis: The third question explicitly overrides the planned attack when the return takes time and balance away.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: Two Misses. One Clue.
lessons.text: Check your spacing. Then choose the fix.
lessons.basis: One miss has good spacing and needs a bigger target, so the voice must not prescribe more footwork after every miss.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: Have You Earned the Attack?
lessons.existingCourtCue: See the space. Check your arrival.
lessons.text: See the opening. Check your arrival.
lessons.basis: An open corner does not warrant an attack while still chasing.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: Defence Can Change Before You Hit
lessons.existingCourtCue: Need time? Buy it with height and depth.
lessons.text: Need time? Add height and depth.
lessons.basis: Conditional recovery cue; early arrival can also make controlled pressure available.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: Have You Earned the Net?
lessons.existingCourtCue: Arrive first. Then decide whether to follow.
lessons.text: Arrive first. Then decide whether to follow.
lessons.basis: Arrival, ball height, opponent position and approach quality inform commitment to the net.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: The Centre Is Not the Plan
lessons.text: Read their options. Recover to cover them.
lessons.basis: Recovery depends on opponent angles and available time; patterns warrant a small adjustment, not a blind guess.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: The Safe Second Serve Trap
lessons.text: Read the receiver. Make contact awkward.
lessons.basis: Height works for one receiver, width for another. Avoid prescribing kick on every second serve.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: The Return That Shrinks Serve +1
lessons.text: Under pressure? Return deep through the middle.
lessons.basis: A stretched return benefits from depth and central margin; a soft serve with time can instead be attacked.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.

lessons.title: The Lead That Makes You Smaller
lessons.text: Keep your depth. Read the opponent.
lessons.basis: Keep depth under scoreboard pressure while adapting to the opponent and the ball.
lessons.scoreEligibility: Any completed score; no claim that the user answered correctly or improved on court.
